page.layout: One page of text, single column: heading INDEX at top, index lines with page numbers at right, then letter Z, one entry, then FINIS and a woodcut ornament below. No margin notes.
page.notes: Woodcut ornament (heart-shaped floral piece) below FINIS, not transcribed. Entries in the index are italic; page numbers are printed at the right margin of each line. Ampersand in the Z entry is printed as a ligature (Et-style sign). Printed numbers 396, 548, 549 and 179 are as printed; the last number in the Z entry is set on a separate line beneath it.
